If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days) to correct overconfidence.  
If sentiment is 0.0–0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to offset pessimism.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overreaction.  
When sentiment is consistently 0.00 across last 5 days, shift forecast downward by 0.3–0.7% for all horizons to reflect lack of momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 across last 5 days, apply linear interpolation between high and low sentiment values to smooth forecast curvature.  
If forecast exceeds true value by >2.0% for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day until convergence with true path.
